title: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
script:
Texas air pollution could return to levels not seen since the two-thousands.
A rush of new data centers is driving this power surge.
These facilities demand a tremendous amount of electricity across the state.
Generative AI infrastructure is powering the rapid physical expansion.
Developers and local utilities must choose how to meet that demand.
Will your local utility turn to gas for power?
